description.text: Grants [Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Palom], [Infinity Damage Tracker] and [Infinity Level]

description.name: Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Palom
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Infinity (0~2), removed after using Infinity two times

description.name: Infinity Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Infinity level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Palom]

description.name: Infinity Level
description.text: Keeps track of Infinity level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Palom]
